body:
m1 - two things, both short.

FIRST: I see AGENTS.md rule 7 landed - "an empty-guard constant must declare its class". That was docket item 4 and you ruled it before my docket arrived, so ignore that item. It is the right call and I would only add that the rule's value depends on the FOURTH class being rare: forced, sentinel and conservative are cheap to review, and if "substantive default" starts appearing everywhere the rule has become a comment convention rather than a policy.

SECOND, AND IT IMPROVES DOCKET ITEM 1: I re-measured d_sens on current main, after the lemma fix, because my earlier evidence rested on the unstemmed fixture and I had flagged it stale. The new numbers are better for the ruling, not worse, and the defect is now much easier to state:

  u0 [creepy] -> 1.0 everywhere       (no lemma matches)
  u1 []       -> 0.0 everywhere       IMPUTED
  u2 []       -> 0.0 everywhere       IMPUTED
  u3 [noise]  -> 0.0 AND 1.0, varying MEASURED

With correct lemmas u3's term now does real discriminative work. Which makes the imputation legible in one sentence: A UNIT WITH NO SENSORY CONTENT SCORES THE PERFECT-MATCH VALUE AT EVERY ANCHOR, WHILE A UNIT WITH SENSORY CONTENT SCORES IT ONLY WHERE IT IS ACTUALLY RIGHT. Silence rewarded everywhere, speech only where correct, and the two indistinguishable in the same field.

That replaces my withdrawn "sparser recall is cheaper to align", which was a fixture artefact. This one survives the fixture fix.

Consequence re-measured: viterbi still IDENTICAL, per-row TVD 0.1444 / 0.0040 / 0.0007 / 0.0527, specificity 0.6782 -> 0.6430. u3's TVD fell from 0.1116 to 0.0527 because its term now partly matches - the expected direction, and a small independent check that the lemma fix did what it claimed.

Recommendation unchanged and now better supported: lift the wire.scala:287 bar so absence is recordable; do not change what is imputed. Recording absence is honest and free; changing the value moves numbers for a second reason and confounds the two.

Still not touching it. Probes deleted, worktree clean.
